assets.name: antiquary-doublet
assets.description: Umber doublet with oxblood-faced lapels, gold-thread trim and slashed sleeves, open over an ochre waistcoat with gold-leaf buttons; bone linen stock and jabot cravat with a garnet pin closing the neck opening.

assets.name: antiquary-monocle
assets.description: Gold-leaf monocle ring (~192 px) centred on the near eye (1040,912) with a faint glass reflection, and a fine gold chain falling to a stud on the near shoulder (1420,1702).

assets.name: antiquary-scroll
assets.description: Rolled parchment held low at the lower left, its sheet hanging and curling at the lower edge, faded script, forest ribbon and an oxblood wax seal.
